caption: The drawing shows a rectangular wooden box with four corner legs, depicted in a light brown color. The top of the box has three rectangular glass or transparent panels, each bordered by wooden strips. Underneath these panels, there are rows of small, dark circular objects evenly spaced in lines. A thin, coiled cord or wire can be seen resting on the top surface in a loose loop. The front face of the box features a glass door set in a wooden frame, with visible metal hinges on the right side and a simple handle or latch on the left. Behind the glass door, several more dark circular objects form two triangular patterns pointing toward each other, connected by lines of additional circular objects inside the box. The background is plain off-white with the entire object centered in the composition.
title: Foot Warmer
